description: Linha e Terminais de Metrô de RMBH - ARMBH 2020 (Minas Gerais) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Mapeamento de localização geográfica das estações e da Rede de tráfego do metrô do município de Belo Horizonte. Elaborado a partir de restituição aerofotogramétrica das imagens do aerolevantamento realizado em 2015 pela PBH, utilizando software de informação geográfica (SIG). Fonte: Plano metropolitano de Belo Horizonte Link:. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Transporte metroviário, Transporte coletivo, Mobilidade urbana, RMBH, Região Metropolitana de Belo Horizonte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
